name: 6A Unit 1 - Let's Give a Hand
description: 關於 Let's Give a Hand 的閱讀理解問答
creator: 系統預置

questions.question: Why doesn't Mike want any birthday presents from his friends?
questions.answer: It is because he wants them to donate money to a charity instead.

questions.question: What voluntary work will Anna do next month?
questions.answer: She'll visit an elderly home and make crafts with the elderly.

questions.question: What is "Heroes for Animals Society"?
questions.answer: It is a charity which takes care of animals without homes.

questions.question: What charity work have you done before?
questions.answer: I have sold flags and adopted a pet before.
